plain: Not yet cancelled, so still in force, as a law

webster.text: Not repealed; not revoked or abrogated; remaining in force.

example.quote: It was resolved, hy seven states, that the prohibition in the secretary's instruction should be repealed ; whereby the unrepealed part of his instructions authorized him to make a treaty, yielding that inestimable navigation, although, by the Confederation, nine states were necessary to concur in the formation ot a treaty !
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 13, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
